Testimoni.label: Testimonials
Testimoni.title: From couples who've already said yes
Testimoni.quote1: Our guests thought we hired an agency. It was just us, one evening, and Rimba.
Testimoni.detail1: We published the invitation the same night we picked the theme. Relatives RSVP'd on WhatsApp within minutes — my mother didn't have to explain anything to anyone.
Testimoni.quote2: The check-in queue at our venue simply didn't exist.
Testimoni.detail2: Guests scanned their personal QR at the door and walked straight in. We watched the dashboard fill up from the family table — 340 guests, zero clipboards.
